title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 20: A Fair Trial

planning.voiceReason: Competing ideas of fairness and competence shape a consequential hiring decision.
planning.earlyCare: Min arrives early to protect the applicant from another dismissal, but is anxious about looking authoritative.
planning.desire: Finish fair hiring and reopen the centre quickly.
planning.obstacle: Appearance-based judgment and pressure for unpaid overtime.
planning.dramaticChange: Min accepts a gentle joke about his collar and defends transparent skills and paid trial terms.
planning.sourceBoundary: Candidates face a supervised practical interview. One assessor judges clothes and confidence instead of competence; another wants unpaid overtime to rush the opening. Min, sensitive about his own reputation, backs a fair skills test and written paid trial terms. The group rejects appearance-based selection and sets realistic staffing limits.
sceneActivities: Min adjusts an absurdly turned-up collar; seated applicant and assessor review records. A qualified supervisor checks ground-level sample work; no rooftop work in this episode.

actingSignature.Jonathan: Plain practical questions; open hand at a boundary, quiet attention afterward.
actingSignature.An: Specific limits and short questions; supported seated rest while reviewing, no assumed healing.
actingSignature.Min: Urgent explanations soften into admitting uncertainty; rests attentive when corrected.
actingSignature.Mother: Concrete requests and accurate accounting; no presumed forgiveness or renewed station shift.
actingSignature.Sela: Patient concrete questions; does not reach for private report. Quiet open posture and attentive gaze.
actingSignature.Ivo: Begins with explanations and permissions; shifts to asking his son. Guarded hands, then release into attentive rest.
actingSignature.Ryn: Direct questions about practical requirements; steady response to appearance judgment, visible relief only after clear paid terms.
actingSignature.Vek: Skeptical administrative questions soften into explicit agreement and written limits.

planning.listenerTurn: Ryn tells Min she needs clear terms rather than his praise; listener Min; he stops adjusting his collar and listens.
planning.payoff: A qualified crew accepts transparent work terms; reopening now needs affordable supplies and a restored teaching garden.
planning.freshQuestion: The crew clears the centre's neglected teaching garden. Jon mistakes a nest near the path for an enemy to remove. A knowledgeable gardener redirects the group before anyone rushes at it or strikes the insects. They cordon off the area and work on a safe section, learning why flowers and pollinators matter to the community.

teaser.moment: Min discovers his grandly raised purple collar is crooked, smooths it down and laughs at his own concern with looking important.
